verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprites offer org-level service connections where access can be granted per Sprite, per label, or down to a single endpoint. This is a least-privilege grant for an agent's sandbox, and credentials can be rotated or revoked per Sprite. The evidence is only homepage marketing lines, and it describes brokered access grants rather than issuing scoped Fly.io API tokens. missing for 10: in-depth docs on credential/token scoping (e.g., scoped Fly API or deploy tokens for agents), permission model details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Grant access on purpose: by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint, so a Slack bot can post messages and never touch admin.
Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential. Cut off a single Sprite and the rest never notice.
Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it. Nobody pastes a token.
